tools.name: Brilworks PRD Generator
tools.description: Instantly produces a full Product Requirements Document from a few bullet points—ideal when you need to “write my PRD” without staring at a blank page.
bullets: AI auto-suggests complete feature sets and user stories
Turns raw ideas into a polished, professional PRD in minutes

tools.name: Write My PRD
tools.description: Purpose-built to let you type a sentence like “write PRD for me” and receive a structured, ready-to-share Product Requirements Document in seconds.
bullets: GPT-powered prompts auto-fill every PRD section for you
Clean UI walks you from idea to finished spec in one sitting

tools.description: One prompt is all it takes—Signlz writes your PRD, tech specs, and even the Jira tasks so you can move from idea to execution instantly.
bullets: Single prompt generates complete PRD + linked tasks
Auto-syncs every deliverable to your task manager

tools.name: GetBash PRD Generator
tools.description: Drop any raw material—competitor URLs, meeting notes, or audio recordings—and GetBash writes the PRD for you, no manual drafting required.
bullets: Accepts any input format and auto-builds a PRD
Includes AI chat editor for on-the-fly tweaks

tools.name: ChatPRD
tools.description: Converse with an AI copilot that literally “writes my PRD” for you while coaching you like a virtual CPO.
bullets: Chat interface drafts full PRDs from simple prompts
Built-in feedback loop refines the doc until it’s perfect

tools.name: Aigents
tools.description: A dedicated AI agent that takes your brief and autonomously produces a market-ready PRD, saving you hours of manual work.
bullets: Agent auto-researches and writes the entire PRD
No setup—just enter your idea and get the finished doc

tools.name: Wisary
tools.description: Embedded in Confluence, Wisary asks you clarifying questions and then writes the PRD so you never have to leave your workspace.
bullets: AI prompts you for missing details and auto-creates the PRD
Transforms the spec into ready-to-use user stories and test plans

tools.name: ProdPad CoPilot
tools.description: CoPilot listens to your high-level vision and instantly drafts the PRD, ensuring every requirement is tied to strategy and outcomes.
bullets: Generative AI writes PRDs from simple voice or text input
Auto-links every requirement to OKRs and roadmap items
